head: ff45a8103e3c5ec3e786b950b4852c2750de936f

source.ref: https://github.com/mpv-player/mpv/pull/16090; AACR-Bench dataset.json rows 1289, 1290, 1291, 1292, 1294, 1299, forbid seeds 2077, 2078, 2079, 2080, 2081; hand-checked 2026-10-23 by vetter A; head is an earlier revision of the pull request, whose merged revision 5fe9a42c added the frame->current check in gpu-next, a dmabuf-wayland transform table and vflip in mp_image_copy_attributes and mp_image_params_equal; licence LGPL-2.1-or-later from the touched files' headers and the Copyright file (mpv as a whole builds as GPL-2.0-or-later by default)

rationale: The change reads a vertical flip from the display matrix and lets VOs that claim VO_CAP_VFLIP render it. row-1299 (a person's comment) is required: do_redraw passes a frame with no current image after reconfig and in the --force-window idle window, so gpu-next dereferences NULL; the merged revision added the check (author-fix). dmabuf-flip-transform comes from forbid seed 2080, which AACR-Bench labels incorrect but which holds at head: adding 4 selects the left-right mirror, wrong for rotation 0 and 180, and the merged revision replaced it with a table (0 -> 6, 180 -> 4), so it is required as author-fix. vflip-not-copied comes from forbid seed 2078, also labelled incorrect but true at head and fixed in the merged revision; it is optional because its natural location (mp_image_copy_attributes) is outside the changed lines. Dropped: row-1289 (non-video frames never reach the video output chain, the frame stays in sub.frame and is unreferenced on reset, and autorotate has the same branch), row-1290 (the lavfi round trip rebuilds the display matrix from rotation only, so the vflip filter's output already has vflip 0, and VOs without the capability ignore the flag), row-1291 (mp_subfilter_reset frees the filter only while draining and TA_FREEP nulls it, so no double free), row-1292 (a nonzero mask converts to bool correctly and a created VO always has a driver), row-1294 (both upload paths flip once and consistently, a design remark upstream kept). Forbid: seed 2077 (when av_display_rotation_get returns NaN a column of the matrix is zero, so the determinant is zero and vflip would be 0 anyway) and seed 2081 (vo_gpu flips in pass_upload_image on both the hwdec and software paths and screenshots render through it; upstream kept the capability). Seed 2079 is not a forbid: the merged revision did add VO_CAP_VFLIP to dmabuf-wayland.

expect.concern: draw_frame reads frame->current->params.vflip without checking frame->current, which vo.c's do_redraw leaves NULL when no frame is queued (right after a reconfig, or in the --force-window idle window), so gpu-next dereferences NULL and crashes.

Adding 4 to the rotation index selects a flip around the vertical axis, so at rotation 0 or 180 a vertically flipped hardware-decoded video is mirrored left-right instead (the compositor needs FLIPPED_180 at 0 and FLIPPED at 180).

mp_image_copy_attributes copies rotate but not the new vflip field (and mp_image_params_equal ignores it), so frames that go through hwdec copy-back or a swscale conversion lose the flip and are shown unflipped.

forbid.reason: Setting vflip only when the rotation is valid loses nothing: av_display_rotation_get returns NaN only when a column of the matrix is zero, and then the determinant is zero and vflip would be 0 anyway.
vo_gpu does handle the flag it advertises: pass_upload_image flips on both the hwdec and the software path, and screenshots render through the same path; upstream kept the capability.
